projects.title: Touch the stars
projects.description:
Vanoro is a five-star luxury hotel, built in the heart of the beautiful and historic city of Thessaloniki. Vanoro offers modern rooms and suites for tourists and travelers from local, regional, national, and international businesses.Vanoro trusted us with the identity and branding from its birth. We were together at every step along their journey.

Anza is Vanoro’s exclusive restaurant that offers impressive dishes of Mediterranean cuisine.

We were asked to create a beautiful and unique logo to attract attention immediately after the launch.
